definitions.explanation: A detailed plan for a lesson prepared by a teacher, outlining objectives, activities, materials, and assessment methods. A standard document in Japanese education.

examples.japanese: {指導案|しどうあん}を{作成|さくせい}した。
{研究授業|けんきゅうじゅぎょう}のために{指導案|しどうあん}を{書|か}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I rewrote the lesson plan for the research lesson.

examples.japanese: {新任|しんにん}の{先生|せんせい}は{指導案|しどうあん}の{書|か}き{方|かた}を{先輩|せんぱい}に{教|おそ}わった。
examples.english: The new teacher learned how to write lesson plans from senior colleagues.

notes:
USAGE:
A fundamental document in Japanese teaching practice. Teachers create {指導案|しどうあん} for each class, and more detailed versions are prepared for {研究授業|けんきゅうじゅぎょう} (research lessons observed by other teachers). The full formal name is {学習指導案|がくしゅうしどうあん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指導案|しどうあん}を{書|か}く (to write a lesson plan)
- {指導案|しどうあん}を{作成|さくせい}する (to prepare a lesson plan)
- {学習|がくしゅう}{指導案|しどうあん} (formal lesson plan)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カリキュラム: curriculum — the overall course of study
- {時間割|じかんわり}: timetable — the schedule of classes
